asks.text: Q1 Scope of "any agent": coding agents in a terminal only, or any model session (chat apps, cloud agents) too
options: coding agents in a terminal only
any agent session, including chat and cloud
asks.recommended: coding agents in a terminal only

asks.text: Q2 Where the contract lives: files in each repo with cross-repo references and the UI combining them, or one home for all repos
options: in each repo, references across, the UI combines
asks.recommended: in each repo, references across, the UI combines

asks.text: Q3 ledgr's place: one client of the contract's files (questions and gates are contract records that ledgr renders and answers) or the runtime that owns them
options: the runtime that owns questions and gates

asks.text: Q4 Conformance strictness: graded (a short list blocks, the rest warns) or strict (any violation blocks)
options: graded: a short list blocks, everything else warns
asks.recommended: graded: a short list blocks, everything else warns

asks.text: Q5 The existing WORKPLAN.md convention: replace it, carrying over only unfinished rows, or wrap it as is
options: replace, carry over unfinished rows only
asks.recommended: replace, carry over unfinished rows only

asks.text: Q6 STATE.md: one per lead session, overwritten, capped at about 8 KB, or one per repo
options: one per lead session, overwritten, ~8 KB cap
asks.recommended: one per lead session, overwritten, ~8 KB cap

asks.text: Q7 Who closes a package: the lead when the closure shows in git (you close gated work only), or you close every package
options: the lead on git evidence; you close gated work
asks.recommended: the lead on git evidence; you close gated work

asks.text: Q8 What counts as your word for a gate: a prompt only when a hook saw you submit it, or a record from the UI or ledgr; or any prompt text
options: a hook-witnessed prompt or a UI/ledgr record
any prompt text that says so
asks.recommended: a hook-witnessed prompt or a UI/ledgr record

asks.text: Q9 Model, time and cost: per-agent adapters, shown as "not reported" when unavailable, or required fields the agent must fill
options: adapters derive them; "not reported" when absent
required fields typed by the agent
asks.recommended: adapters derive them; "not reported" when absent
